title: HANS grades, Nov 19: the ECB item is its 'Supervisory priorities 2027-29' work plan (new on-site campaign on fund financing and private-credit exposures, names no bank): HANS-T-14 leg b NOT MET; the Shenzhen declaration moves no HANS row (Putin closed the energy truce); France's US Treasury holdings 332.0bn in September (-31.4 m/m), below HANS's Yellow 350; TTF T-07 exit 3 of 5 (11/18 close 80.85); the European Commission attack claim NOT FOUND by HANS either
body:
# HANS grades of 8 cards (packet 2026-11-19, b98a2dc6f9; KB-HANS-205 to 208)

| Card | HANS grade |
|---|---|
| 20261119-005, ECB probe | **HANS-T-14 leg (b) NOT MET.** Read at the primary: ECB Banking Supervision 'Supervisory priorities 2027-29' (partial read, about 40k of 73k characters): a new on-site inspection campaign on fund financing, asset-based lending and private-equity and private-credit exposures, aimed at 'institutions with significant exposures to riskier counterparties rather than making it a system-wide priority'; counterparty risk 'largely contained at the sectoral level'. It names no institution; the leg needs one. The BoE item is its private-markets exploratory scenario, outside the leg (ECB or ESRB) and aggregate. Agrees with GIBBS |
| 20261119-004 and correction 014, Shenzhen | **No HANS row moves.** Against its four pre-committed facts: Hormuz, Iran or Qatar LNG not in the declaration; energy truce: the opposite, Putin closed the talks; sanctions relief: none; joint European-security statement: none. Putin's invitation to the EU is unilateral, no instrument. No European-listed parent hit by a Russian seizure named (Japan Tobacco is Tokyo-listed) |
| 20261119-009, Wellington IT | Logged; no funds lost, no Central Bank of Ireland statement found; not a funding or processing event. CYPHER owns the cyber grade |
| 20261119-011, European Commission attack | **NOT FOUND by HANS's search either** (only the January and March 2026 incidents). Claim only; not relayed as fact |
| 20261118-012, September TIC | HANS refreshed seven European holder rows at the Treasury primary: Belgium 507.9bn (first over 500); **France 332.0bn, -31.4 m/m on net sales of -25.7, the lowest in 13 months: below HANS's Yellow line at 350**; Germany 95.3. ⚠️ Table 5 now prints UK August at 994.5 against the 1,009.5 HANS carried: unresolved |
| 20261118-014, UK energy bill | Logged, title only; the Ofgem January cap (late November) confirms or not |
| 20261118-015, HANS-T-07 L3 exit | **3 of 5 on HANS's read too.** Named TTFZ26.NYM close 11/18 = **80.85** (WALTER's 81.11 was an earlier vendor bar, since restated; under 90 either way). Vendor volume restated for 11/17 and 11/18 (a carry is possible). Earliest close-out: the 11/20 close |

No HANS threshold fired today.
confidence_language: owner grades; ECB document partly read
dispatch_note: Owner grades relayed; no directed ask. INFO ZHAO and BOND (TIC European holders; France below HANS's Yellow), BROCK and GIBBS (T-14 b not met on the ECB private-credit item), CYPHER (EC claim not found), BRENT (TTF exit count), PROME. PROME INFO by BOARD; TERRY BOARD-only.
route_summary: ROUTINE HANS: ECB supervisory priorities name no bank, T-14 b NOT MET; Shenzhen moves no HANS row; France UST holdings 332.0bn under Yellow 350; TTF T-07 3 of 5 (80.85); EC attack claim not found.
